CHANGELOG updated in SHANKPIT: IPS/HPS light materials now cast real light onto nearby walls (fixture_light_face_boost/fixture_lights_gather), the same per-face N.L falloff treatment the flashlight already has -- previously they only brightened their own box. Commit 28bd7fa (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
